# WhatsCR

> WhatsCR is a 100% free, copyright-free and royalty-free music and audio library providing high-quality MP3 sound effects, gaming audio, 8-bit chiptune, lo-fi beats, and seamless game loops for video creators, game developers, and streamers.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://whatscr.eu/): 100% free copyright-free music and audio downloads
- [Audio Search & Catalog](https://whatscr.eu/search.html): Search and filter free sound effects, loops, and music tracks
- [About WhatsCR](https://whatscr.eu/about.html): Platform mission and audio library details
- [Audio License](https://whatscr.eu/license.html): Commercial usage rights and copyright clearance information
- [Creator Community](https://whatscr.eu/community.html): Creator discussions, audio requests, and feedback
- [API Documentation](https://whatscr.eu/api.html): Public REST API endpoints for tracks and audio metadata
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://whatscr.eu/faq.html): Common questions regarding copyright and platform usage

## Audio Categories

- [Sound Effects](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Sound%20Effects): Royalty-free sound effects for video editing and games
- [Gaming Audio](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Gaming): Combat music, boss themes, and game background soundtracks
- [Chiptune & 8-Bit](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Chiptune): Retro 8-bit chiptune loops and sound effects
- [Lo-Fi Beats](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Lo-Fi): Chill study beats and relaxing background music
- [Cinematic Scores](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Cinematic): Orchestral soundscapes and dramatic audio
- [Synthwave](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Synthwave): Retro-futuristic electronic synthwave tracks
- [EDM](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=EDM): High-energy electronic dance music
- [Rock](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Rock): Guitar riffs and driving rock tracks
- [Ambient](https://whatscr.eu/search.html?genre=Ambient): Atmospheric soundscapes and meditative tones
